component.name: chip8
component.summary: CHIP-8 interpreter with an SDL2 frontend

description.p: A CHIP-8 interpreter in C++20 with an SDL2 window, beeper and keypad mapping, validated against the Timendus chip8-test-suite. Open a .ch8 file with it, or run it with a ROM: flatpak run com.dhivalabs.chip8 game.ch8
